profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer | Motivating Project Manager | Effective Communicator | Analytical Problem Solver
profile.summary: I am a motivated Software Engineer with career success creating, testing and developing software. I have a proven track record in developing designs that improve software and streamline product delivery to enhance customer satisfaction. I am a motivational team leader who is willing to put in the extra effort needed to make a project successful. I am able to communicate, and collaborate across all functions to execute concurrent priorities in a fast-paced environment to maximize performance, improve processes, and deliver innovative solutions.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer Contract
positions.description:
Description: Serving as a senior contractor supporting Gaggle's engineering team, leveraging AI-assisted development tools and AWS cloud services (including AWS CI/CD and CloudFormation) to understand code quickly, accelerate delivery and improve platform reliability.  
- Leveraged AI-assisted development tools (Cursor, Claude) to double the closure rate of tickets per sprint, significantly improving team throughput. 
- Utilized AWS cloud services, including S3 for storage, CloudFormation for infrastructure as code, and CodeBuild/CodePipeline for CI/CD, alongside Docker for containerization, to support scalable, reliable application deployments.
- Contributed to backend development and system enhancements, including creating and using custom AI skills to streamline development workflows.
positions.insights: Skills: Software Design · Software Infrastructure · Contract Engineering · Software Development · AWS CloudFormation
